regular.label: 常规数据集
regular.description: General reference datasets used as the baseline retrieval corpus.

liver_disease.label: 肝病专题数据集
liver_disease.description: Disease-focused liver datasets, including hepatitis, cirrhosis, fibrosis, liver cancer, and related labels.
liver_disease.pre_filter_hint: 检索前按 disease 字段过滤，排除正常样本以聚焦肝病细胞相似性

joint.label: 联合检索数据集
joint.description: Merged vector indexes built from two or more registered datasets.

index_type_notes.flat: 精确搜索，100%召回，适合 < 1万细胞
index_type_notes.ivfflat: 倒排索引，平衡速度与精度，适合 1万-100万细胞。nlist=4*sqrt(N) 自动计算
index_type_notes.ivfpq: 乘积量化压缩，内存小，适合 > 10万细胞。参数 m 需整除向量维度
index_type_notes.hnsw: FAISS 内置 HNSW，高召回，查询快，适合交互式检索
